name: HIST 3362
title: The Black Death: Medieval and Modern Responses to Catastrophe
description: (Also offered as HEJS 3362.) The Black Death (1346-50) from its origins in China through Europe. Institutional, medical, religious, literary, and social responses to the plague; how modern scholars reconstruct medieval experience; and new findings by historians and scientists that shed light on the challenges of past, present and future pandemics. CA 1. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
